record.context_brief: Precise growth behaviour in terms of the growth bound
record.original_question: Let (T (t))t≥0 be a C0 -semigroup with growth bound ω0 := inf{ω ∈ R : kT (t)k ≤ M ω · etω for t ≥ 0} Find condition such that ω0 is a minimum, i.e., kT (t)k ≤ M0 · etω0 for t ≥ 0 .

evidence.quote: Problem 14 (Precise growth behaviour in terms of the growth bound). Let (T (t))t≥0 be a C0 -semigroup with growth bound ω0 := inf{ω ∈ R : kT (t)k ≤ M ω · etω for t ≥ 0} Find condition such that ω0 is a minimum, i.e., kT (t)k ≤ M0 · etω0 for t ≥ 0 .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a Banach space and let $(T(t))_{t\geq 0}$ be a $C_0$-semigroup on $X$, i.e., a family of bounded linear operators on $X$ such that $T(0)=I$, $T(t+s)=T(t)T(s)$ for all $t,s\geq 0$, and $t\mapsto T(t)x$ is continuous from $[0,\infty)$ into $X$ for each $x\in X$. Define the growth bound by
$$\omega_0 := \inf\{\omega\in\mathbb{R} : \text{there exists } M_\omega\geq 1 \text{ such that } \|T(t)\|\leq M_\omega\, e^{t\omega}\text{ for all } t\geq 0\}.$$
Find necessary and/or sufficient conditions on the semigroup $(T(t))_{t\geq 0}$ (or, equivalently, on its generator) under which the infimum defining $\omega_0$ is attained, i.e., there exists a constant $M_0\geq 1$ such that
$$\|T(t)\|\leq M_0\, e^{t\omega_0}\qquad\text{for all } t\geq 0.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question of characterizing when the growth bound of a C0-semigroup is attained as a minimum (i.e., when one has the bound ‖T(t)‖ ≤ M₀ e^{tω₀} with the optimal exponent) is a recognized open problem in semigroup theory. General references on semigroup growth bounds and asymptotic behavior discuss related questions (e.g., the spectral mapping/spectral-determined growth condition, and the relation s(A) ≤ ω₀(T)) but no general characterization of when ω₀ is attained appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Semigroup growth bounds (van Neerven)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses various growth bounds of C0-semigroups, the relation between spectral bound and growth bound, and notes non-attainment phenomena.
status_evidence.claim: There are well-known examples in which the infimum in the definition of ω₀ is not attained, and no general characterization of attainment is given.

status_evidence.title: C0-semigroup - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Defines the growth bound ω₀ as an infimum and notes that ‖T(t)‖ ≤ M_ω e^{ωt} only holds for ω > ω₀ in general.
status_evidence.claim: Standard formulations state the bound only for ω strictly greater than ω₀, indicating that attainment is a nontrivial extra condition.
